_comment: forge spec: success criteria as NUMBERS, written BEFORE modeling. `forge verify <stl> --spec spec.json` prints every line as PASS/FAIL in plain words; `forge report` shows 'Checks: N of N green'. Simple parts need only the first three keys (bbox_mm, components, min_wall_mm). Delete this key or keep it; unknown keys are ignored.
name: mypart

fit._comment: every number that decides whether the part FITS something, with where it came from. Sources: measured | datasheet | parts-find | photofit | user | library | ASSUMED. An ASSUMED fit number stamps the Print Report NOT FIT-CHECKED.

checks._comment: named requirements, one line each, printed PASS/FAIL in plain words. Types: hole, empty_at, solid_at, fits, height_mm.
